title: Curated leftover probes
description:
Maintain a curated catalog of ways to read current included-quota leftover for products Anthus uses. Wrap existing tools (cclimits, CodexBar, later others). Do not invent scrapers.

Pin command, JSON shape, windows, reset, last-verified date, fail-closed behavior.

Products we do not run land only via a working PR plus help verifying. See docs/leftover.md and docs/contributing-providers.md.

DoD: each Anthus product we care about has a named probe module, a fixture, and a last-verified date. Unreadable leftover never dispatches.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Research dump for leftover probes: docs/research/leftover-tool-landscape.md. Includes aiquota (github.com/kohii/aiquota), aiquota.app, aiuse (github.com/djbclark/aiuse), plus community hubs (CodexBar, ccusage spend-only, tokscale, claude-swap, Claude-Code-Usage-Monitor, Win-CodexBar) and smaller CLIs. Unsorted; later agents should pick a wrap hub. Not a wrap decision.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Settled ranking from a second session: CodexBar first for live leftover, then OpenUsage.ai (robinebers/openusage, local 127.0.0.1:6736/v1/limits), then tokscale usage --json. ccusage is historical spend, not remaining-%. aiuse/aiquota are glue, not the community. Skip Claude-Code-Usage-Monitor (last push 2026-07). Healthy repos watch; they do not dispatch. Recorded in docs/research/leftover-tool-landscape.md and docs/related-tools.md.
